column1: # Size sweep, for judging changes to the layout of Molecule and Complex.
# cases.tsv spans 100 to 3,955 molecules, which is the range the branch's other
# changes cared about.  It is not a size sweep, and section 22 of RESULTS.md
# measured a layout effect that is invisible below about 6,000 molecules and
# worth 1.21x at 40,000.  Judging a layout change on cases.tsv alone returns
# "no effect" for a change that has one.
# Generate the models first:
#   ./make_scale_inputs.sh
# then point the harness at them:
#   ROOT_DIR=results/scale_inputs CASES_FILE=scale_cases.tsv \
#     ./interleaved_timing.sh 7 base=<bin> cand=<bin>
# scale_* are rev_3D with the copy numbers multiplied and the box side scaled by
# the cube root of the same factor, so density and chemistry are unchanged and
# only the memory footprint moves.  enzyme is a real model, the largest in
# sample_inputs that runs.
# nItr is chosen so each case takes roughly five to thirty seconds per run on an
# Apple M5, and so that setup is a small fraction of it: coordinate generation
# alone is 0.44 s CPU at 10,000 molecules and 3.97 s at 40,000, which is why
# scale_40k is not run for fewer iterations than this.
# Molecule-array footprints at 656 bytes per molecule, against a 128 KB L1D and
# a 16 MB L2 on the reference host:
#   scale_2k    2,000 molecules   1.3 MB
#   enzyme      6,410 molecules   4.2 MB
#   scale_10k  10,000 molecules   6.6 MB
#   scale_40k  40,000 molecules  26.2 MB   -- past L2
# Columns: id <TAB> input directory <TAB> parm file <TAB> nItr
scale_2k
